extracted.name: Crispy Air Fryer Fried Chicken
ingredient_lines: 1 tsp Seasoning of choice (for dry mix)
2 tbsp Frank’s RedHot Wings Buffalo Sauce
instruction_lines: Marinate chicken with mixed spices for at least 2 hours.
In one bowl, mix flour, cornstarch, salt, paprika, and seasoning.
In another bowl, whisk egg, sparkling water, and spices.
Coat chicken: dip in wet mix, then dry mix.
Place on air fryer pan, spray with oil.
Air fry at 190°C for 30 minutes, flipping at 15 minutes.
For buffalo sauce, mix all sauce ingredients.
Coat cooked chicken in buffalo sauce. Optionally, air fry 2 more minutes and coat again.
For dip, mix yogurt, herbs, oregano, paprika, and lime juice.
Serve chicken hot with yogurt dip on the side.
